questions.q: What determines who must approve a given requisition in Oracle Fusion Cloud?
options: A single hard-coded approver for the entire company
The requisition number, in numerical order
Whichever employee is logged in first that day
Configurable approval rules that can consider amount, item category, business unit, and the requester's supervisory hierarchy
questions.explain: Approvals are driven by configurable rules evaluated against factors like amount, category, BU, and hierarchy, not a single fixed approver.

questions.q: Why does Dana's requisition only route to her direct supervisor?
options: The amount is modest and the item category (routine MRO parts) does not trigger additional approval rules
All requisitions only ever require one approver
Self Service Procurement requisitions never require approval
Her supervisor is the only person with system access
questions.explain: Because the purchase is modest in value and a routine, pre-approved category, LTV's approval rules route it to just her direct supervisor.

questions.q: Dana says her requisition appears 'stuck.' What is the most likely explanation, based on how approvals work?
options: The system deleted her requisition
It is most likely sitting in an approver's worklist, waiting for action she cannot take herself
Requisitions expire automatically after one hour
She must have entered the wrong supplier
questions.explain: A requester can see the status but cannot advance the approval themselves - the document is simply waiting in the approver's queue.

questions.q: What happens if an approver rejects Dana's requisition?
options: It is permanently deleted with no way to resubmit
It is automatically approved anyway after 24 hours
It returns to Dana with a reason, and she can revise and resubmit it, restarting the applicable approval routing
It is automatically converted into a purchase order regardless
questions.explain: Rejection sends the requisition back to the requester with a reason; resubmission restarts the approval routing against the current rules.

questions.q: Why might increasing the quantity on an already-approved requisition line trigger reapproval?
options: Reapproval is never triggered by editing a requisition
The change could cause the requisition to cross an amount threshold that the original approval routing did not anticipate
Oracle Fusion requires reapproval only for service items, never for goods
Editing a requisition always cancels it automatically
questions.explain: Because approval rules often key off amount, a material change like a quantity increase can push a document past a threshold and require reapproval.
